summary: Two men, ages 23 and 21, found drowned at the bottom of one of the Poudre Ponds in Greeley after a citizen reported personal items (wallet, clothing, cell phone) abandoned on the bank; Greeley Fire Department's Water Rescue/Dive Team located both bodies with sonar and recovered them; Weld County Coroner responded; deaths appear accidental
location: Poudre Ponds, 900 block of North 35th Avenue, Greeley
responding_agency: Greeley Police Department; Greeley Fire Department Water Rescue/Dive Team; Weld County Coroner
notes: Date 2024-06-27 = Thursday per the Greeley PD release ('On Thursday, June 27, 2024'); dive-team training exercise diverted to recovery
